    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-width/full-height separator lines partition the grid into panels.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_spans = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1)]
    col_spans = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds) - 1)]

    def cells(rs, cs):
        r0, r1 = rs
        c0, c1 = cs
        return [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1)] for r in range(r0, r1)]

    # Each adjacent pair of panels is a left/right mirror pair. Complete the
    # missing member by reflecting the occupied panel horizontally.
    for rs in row_spans:
        for left in range(0, len(col_spans) - 1, 2):
            a, b = col_spans[left], col_spans[left + 1]
            pa, pb = cells(rs, a), cells(rs, b)
            occupied_a = any(v != 0 for row in pa for v in row)
            occupied_b = any(v != 0 for row in pb for v in row)
            if occupied_a == occupied_b:
                continue
            src_span, dst_span = (a, b) if occupied_a else (b, a)
            src_c0, src_c1 = src_span
            dst_c0, dst_c1 = dst_span
            r0, r1 = rs
            for rr in range(r0, r1):
                for offset in range(src_c1 - src_c0):
                    val = grid[rr][src_c1 - 1 - offset] if occupied_a else grid[rr][src_c0 + offset]
                    out[rr][dst_c0 + offset] = val
    return out
